decisions.what: Created minimal valid 1x1 JPEG placeholders for corporate-office.jpg and financial-security.jpg
decisions.why: Task requires image files at these paths; a real Unsplash download is out of scope for this offline code-generation workflow, so minimal valid JPEG bytes were written so browsers can still resolve the asset.

decisions.what: Appended trust-section, company-overview, educational-cards, edu-card, edu-card-content, and social-link styles to styles.css before the prefers-reduced-motion block
decisions.why: CSS spec (003) explicitly lists these classes with concrete rules (padding, grid, filter grayscale, 60-degree clip-path via polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 85%, 0 100%), mix-blend-mode multiply, hover states, and responsive adjustments); placed before reduced-motion query to preserve cascade order.

decisions.what: Added trust-section class to the existing <section id="trust"> and inserted company-overview, educational-cards, and social-links inside it
decisions.why: Spec 004 says 'In the trust section, add ...' — kept the existing content and appended the new blocks so the new CSS applies and no prior work is discarded.

decisions.what: Used inline SVG icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube inside the social links
decisions.why: Spec allows SVG or font icons; inline SVG avoids adding a FontAwesome dependency and keeps the page dependency-free, matching the project's existing pattern of local SVG assets.

decisions.what: Added prefers-reduced-motion overrides for .edu-card:hover img and .social-link:hover
decisions.why: styles.css already had a prefers-reduced-motion block; extending it keeps the new hover transforms accessible.
